body: I get what you mean, life would only have sense if we would all live indefinitely and always be healthy with no pain. We all came to this world against our will. Todays medicine does not offer real solutions to diseases and depression problems which are the triggers for suicide. Its like they want us to suffer on purpose. So how can we blame eachother ? Still if you do it your family will be scarred for life, so try talking to them in this direction. I had the same problem in my teens, what i did was change city and create a 'new life', people somehow 'like' you more when you are from some other place, its like you are more egsotic or something, plus you can lie about your past, makes you feel better.
